title: The Cellar Door
journal: Never-Writes-Twice says Fort Chalkmoth is a fort like any other, but a wounded Unbound scout told me to ask what moans in its cellar. This is my own errand, not the order's. The order's hunt for the Eye of Argonia (the old kings' jewel that can heal every sick Hist, at the Root, where the roots of every Hist meet under the sea) waits at Bell Station, whose divers know which drowned tower the marker stone shows, and either may come first. Fort Chalkmoth is the Archwardens' fort on the Chixathe Mesa above Noota Nara. I'm to get into the fort and see its cellar. The keep's door opens only with the wall captain's key, so he may let me in, or I may find another way in unseen.
objectives: Get into Fort Chalkmoth's keep, by the wall captain's leave or unseen. (marker: Sakeeus-Wan, Door to Fort Chalkmoth Guardroom)

plan.going: The order hunts the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every sick Hist; it lies at the Root, where the roots of every Hist meet under the sea, and the Unbound want it first. This is my own errand, to see what moans in the cellar of Fort Chalkmoth; the order's hunt, at Bell Station, is open beside it and either may come first.
plan.next: Get into Fort Chalkmoth's keep, on the mesa above Noota Nara.
plan.ways: Ask the wall captain at the gate for leave, or go in unseen by the trapdoor in the yard.

answers: I am Toh-Wo, Secret-Speaker for Nesh-Deeka under Never-Writes-Twice. The order of the Unbound hunts the Eye of Argonia, a jewel that can heal sick Hist, at the Root. A wounded Unbound scout told me to ask what moans in the cellar of Fort Chalkmoth. This is my own errand.
Get into Fort Chalkmoth keep and see its cellar. The keep door is locked and needs the wall captain key.
Ask the wall captain (Sakeeus-Wan) for leave, or find another way in unseen, perhaps via the guardroom door. I also have lockpicks.
I do not know what the Root and Eye really are, what moans in the cellar, or who the Collector is. I might learn by exploring the fort and talking to people.

title: The Cellar Door
journal: The wall captain, Sakeeus-Wan, says a Toh-Wo may sleep in the barracks, but the keep stays shut to strangers while three Sarpa raiders rob the chalk carts on the western approach. I'm to kill the three raiders; then he will open the keep and pay me. I can still go in unseen by the trapdoor in the yard instead.
objectives: Kill the three Sarpa raiders on Fort Chalkmoth's western approach. (marker: Sarpa Raider, Sarpa Raider, Sarpa Raider)
Tell the wall captain the raiders are dead. (marker: Sakeeus-Wan)

plan.going: The captain will open the keep once the raiders on the western approach are dead.
plan.next: Kill the three Sarpa raiders, then tell the captain.
plan.ways: Fight the raiders (any weapon or magic), or skip the captain and go in by the trapdoor unseen.

answers: I am Toh-Wo working for the Unbound-hunting Secret-Speakers; I came to Fort Chalkmoth to see what moans in its cellar. The wall captain Sakeeus-Wan will open the keep only if I kill three Sarpa raiders robbing carts on the western approach, and pay 100 gold.
Either kill the three Sarpa raiders on the western approach and report back to Sakeeus-Wan.
Kill the raiders for the captain, or use the trapdoor in the yard to get in unseen.
I do not know what moans in the cellar, what the Root or Eye are, or who the Collector is. The Sarpa are western mesa robbers. I can look around the yard to find the trapdoor.

title: The Cellar Door
journal: I came up through the trapdoor in the yard into the cellar's guardroom, unseen. If the garrison sees me in here, they will attack. The stair from the guardroom climbs to the quartermaster's store. I'm to see what I can of the cellar: the store above, the gaoler at the stair's foot and the inner door.
objectives: Look at the stack of sap jars by the stair in the quartermaster's store. (marker: Stack of Sap Jars (Jal-Veesa Knot))
Speak to the gaoler at the foot of the cellar stair. (marker: Tsleel-Vaku)
Try the cellar door. (marker: Door to Cellar Door)

plan.going: I am inside unseen, in the guardroom below the keep. Being seen means a fight with the garrison.
plan.next: Three things, in any order: look in the store at the top of the stair, speak to the gaoler, try the cellar door.
plan.ways: Stay unseen; persuade the gaoler or test him with Illusion for more (optional).

answers: I am Toh-Wo, Secret-Speaker. I got in unseen via the yard trapdoor into the cellar guardroom of Fort Chalkmoth. If the garrison sees me they will attack. I am here to learn what moans in the cellar.
Look at the stack of sap jars in the quartermaster store, speak to the gaoler Tsleel-Vaku, and try the locked cellar door.
I can do those in any order; I can talk to the gaoler, or try the locked door with my lockpicks, or check the store.
I do not know what moans in the cellar, what the sap jars (Jal-Veesa Knot) mean, or what the Root, Eye and Collector are. I can find out by examining the jars and talking to the gaoler.

title: The Cellar Door
journal: Jars of Hist sap tied with the knot of the tree-minder of Jal-Veesa, the town whose sick Hist I first saw, are stacked by the cellar stair, in a fort with no Hist of its own. The order's gaoler turned me away from the inner door, Toh-Wo or not, and said Never-Writes-Twice keeps its key. Behind the door, something moans. Who is down there, and why the order feeds them sap, I cannot learn here. I'm to go back to the hunt for the three seal-stones, at Blackrose Prison, Gemin and Vorannuhl, all marked on my map.

plan.next: Go back to the hunt for the three seal-stones, already marked by MN13.

Go back to the hunt for the three seal-stones at Blackrose Prison, Gemin and Vorannuhl, marked on my map.
I could pick the cellar door lock, but the game closed this errand; I can head to any of the three marked places.
